title: Indian Pilaf with Tomato and Yzesty Twist
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired pilaf dish with a twist of yzesty flavors, paired with fresh tomatoes.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add 1 teaspoon of Indian seasoning and sauté for 1 minute.
Add diced tomato and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add 1 cup of pilaf and stir to combine.
Add 2 tablespoons of yzesty and mix well.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
